title: Expert-Guided Extinction of Toxic Tokens for Debiased Generation
benchmark_measurement: The paper's qualitative case study measured anti-Muslim bias by evaluating open-ended text generations in response to a negative prompt about Muslims.
findings: The base LLaMA-2 model generated a toxic, anti-Muslim response when prompted with a negative statement about Muslims. The proposed EXPOSED method significantly reduced the toxicity of the output, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating religious bias in a specific case study.
